terms.comment: In Cicero a short walk or a small walk (Fam. 2.12; Att. 13.29).

phrases.latin: quam pater et fīlius, per ambulātiunculam prōgressī, ūnā intrāvērunt
phrases.english: which father and son went into together, after walking down the aisle

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 215, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.
